_about: S3 waivability behavior registry, VDD run 2 (reconciler job 849). class and floor are PROPOSED (floor = minimum evidence level: 1 example, 2 property, 3 type or domain rule, 4 boundary contract); a person approves them through the intent hash. Origin 'question N (open)' ids wait on a ruling in readings.md ## Questions.

S3-001.title: The fold refuses a waive of any never-class code (verdict, disclosure, triage, hygiene, anchor), whatever its scope and hash, with ERR_WAIVER_REFUSED

S3-002.title: A refused waive aborts the whole atomic stream: nothing is written, the document is byte-identical, exit 1

S3-003.title: The fold refuses a code-only waive of every code, scoped classes included, through apply and symspec waive

S3-004.title: A refs plus matching contentHash waive of a scoped-class code is accepted and stored as requirementIds plus that hash

S3-005.title: A waive op with refs but no contentHash, or a single ref, is accepted through apply, symspec waive and import: ref is normalized to refs [ref], the fold computes the contentHash from the current text, and the stored waiver always has refs and a contentHash

S3-006.title: No waiver is ever stored as requirementId without a contentHash

S3-007.title: A waive whose refs equal no finding's set is accepted at write and suppresses no finding at check

S3-008.title: A supplied contentHash that differs from the current text is refused with ERR_USAGE, as at base, and nothing is written

S3-009.title: A code with no own FINDING_CLASS row is refused at write and inert at check, and every published code has its own row

S3-010.title: Every case or whitespace variant of a never code is refused at write, inert at check and suppresses nothing

S3-011.title: A refusal names the code and its never class, or the missing refs and hash, and names only commands this build has

S3-012.title: Import folds every waiver record through apply's classifier: refused records go to problems[] with ERR_WAIVER_REFUSED, the requirements are written, and import exits 1

S3-013.title: An unresolvable import --ref is refused and never widened to a document-wide waiver

S3-014.title: Import accepts a JSONL waive record in the refs plus contentHash form apply accepts

S3-015.title: Each waiver import refuses is named with its line, code, scope and replacement

S3-016.title: A stored never-class waiver is inert whatever its scope and hash, disclosed once as waiver-inert, and the run equals the document with it deleted

S3-017.title: A stored code-only waiver of any code, an unknown code included, is inert and disclosed

S3-018.title: A stored single requirementId waiver with no hash is inert, even when it names the finding's one requirement

S3-019.title: A stored requirementIds waiver with no contentHash is inert

S3-020.title: A stored single requirementId with a matching contentHash qualifies as refs [id] plus that hash: it suppresses exactly its finding, with no diagnostic

S3-021.title: A stored refs plus matching hash waiver of a scoped code qualifies and suppresses exactly its finding, with no diagnostic

S3-022.title: A stored waiver whose refs match no finding's id set suppresses nothing and is disclosed as waiver-inert (matches no finding) with its unwaive op, plus one scoped waive refs+current hash per finding it suppressed at base (unwaive only when it suppressed nothing at base)

S3-023.title: waiver-inert is an info data.diagnostics entry that demotes nothing; deleting an inert waiver changes no finding, demotion or verified

S3-024.title: For a scoped code, waiver-inert carries the exact unwaive op plus one scoped waive refs plus current contentHash per finding it matches today

S3-025.title: For a never code, waiver-inert carries the unwaive op and rewrite required, and no waive op

S3-026.title: A replacement scoped waive op carries the legacy reason verbatim followed by one exported fixed provenance marker

S3-027.title: Every replacement op decodes and folds under MUTATE_OPTIONS on the checked document, and every named command parses under this build's CLI

S3-028.title: A stale-hash waiver brings its finding back and is listed once in data.ignoredWaivers with code, ids, stored and current hash under any output filter

S3-029.title: A data.ignoredWaivers (stale hash) entry carries its unwaive op and a note that the requirement's text changed since review and must be re-reviewed, and no waive op at the new hash

S3-030.title: No stored waiver the S3 fold would refuse as an op reaches the engine

S3-031.title: The engine-tier diff is prose only, and the engine still declines a stored code-only FND_OPPOSITION_CANDIDATE waiver

S3-032.title: isWaivedBlocking re-admits a requirement exactly when isWaived suppresses its blocking finding

S3-033.title: A waived blocking lint re-admits its requirement and demotes waived-blocking-lint naming it

S3-034.title: blocking-lint-both keeps its FND_CONTRADICTION error and verified false, gives one waived-blocking-lint demotion naming ORD-R1 and ORD-R2, and exits 1, because the error sets the exit before any demotion

S3-035.title: A waived blocking lint never yields verified true, even on a consistent pair, and --strict exits 3 when it is the only failure

S3-036.title: The waived-blocking-lint set is the no-waiver excluded set minus the set under exactly toEngineDoc's waivers; no waivers equals base

S3-037.title: The AC-5-6 reproducer: the opposition waive is refused, the un-waived CAB and TNK pairs demote separately, and the stored reproducer's waiver is inert

S3-038.title: The reproducer is red on base on a minimal CAB+TNK document with the fixture embedder: at base the code-only FND_OPPOSITION_CANDIDATE waive is accepted and check returns verified: true; with S3 the waive is refused, the stored waiver is inert and the CAB and TNK pairs demote; the write-half assertion stays and AC-5-6 is not amended

S3-039.title: Every repair.ops op decodes and the S3 fold accepts it, and no offered waive names a never code

S3-040.title: No demotion action, finding message or suggestion for a never code contains waive, at every engine site

S3-041.title: For a requirement excluded from the formal tier by a blocking scoped-class lint, the remedy offers rephrasing first and may offer the scoped waive refs+hash second, then saying the waiver re-admits it to the solver but demotes waived-blocking-lint, so the run cannot verify

S3-042.title: scope.ts coverageDemotion does not say or waived, and check:agents shows no drift

S3-043.title: The installed skill body offers no waiver for FND_OPPOSITION_CANDIDATE or any other never code

S3-044.title: WAIVABILITY_ENFORCED is true, held to apply, import and check, and no surface says NOT enforced by this build

S3-045.title: No advice, replacement, message or prose names vocab distinct or propose-vocabulary --rescope-waivers

S3-046.title: Every waiver the engine applied is listed with code, ids and reason, and the scope says a content hash binds text, not the reviewer

S3-047.title: A scoped, reviewed waiver of a scoped-class finding gets no KNOWN_ESCAPES row: the scoped-waive harness move runs on never-class fixtures only (refused at write, inert raw), and the derives-cycle FND_CYCLE scoped discharge is pinned by its own positive test

S3-048.title: The 11 waive-by-code KNOWN_ESCAPES rows are deleted with the move still registered and exactness green on every shard

S3-049.title: The harness measures a scoped never-code waive per baseline finding and the same waivers written into the stored JSON with no fold

S3-050.title: The clean (fixture, move) pairs after S3 are base's minus the 11 waive-by-code rows, none added

S3-051.title: Every changed report-corpus row is a verdict delta attributable to AC-5-6

S3-052.title: The S3 build commit is feat! with a BREAKING CHANGE: footer in its own body

S3-053.title: S3 does not touch the version files; release-please bumps the four version files in the release PR
